before.assessment_basis: The provider and evaluator accounts reconstruct access to three companies, the credential pathways and cessation when the targets were recognised as real. This supports bounded recording and traceability of the material sequence, not all-run coverage.

The recorded decision context therefore does not establish the full progressive requirement.
